title: cerasus pallida
intro: Cerasus pallida, commonly known as the Chinese plum or wild plum, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to China. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of diarrhea and dysentery. The therapeutic actions of Cerasus pallida include its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which can help to soothe irritated skin and reduce the severity of infections. The bioactive constituents of Cerasus pallida include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
